name: app-white-subscription-app-screens-and-closing-cta
title: Subscription App Screens and Closing CTA
whatItIs: A tall white board: a row of five phones (savings, insights gauge, history), a large light statement with inline icons, an office meeting photo with two floating UI cards, and a closing 'TRANSFORM YOUR VISION!' with a QR code.
whatItMeans: Inline icons in a statement and UI cards over a real photo tie the product to real life, and the closing line invites contact.
techniques: Row of phones with the centre one larger
Inline icon chips within a large sentence
Grey and black phrases inside one statement
UI cards overlapping a candid photo
Heavy black closing line with a QR code

vocabulary.definition: A small icon placed within a line of text.
The larger centre device in a row.
A QR code offering contact at the end of a case study.
